verdict.rationale: Puzzle ships a dedicated month-end close feature, AI Close, which uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies, alongside documented bank and card reconciliation and accrual-basis accounting. However, nothing in the evidence shows an actual close checklist, per-item status tracking, or formal review sign-offs. Missing for 10: an explicit close checklist with task tracking, accrual tasks tracked within the close, reviewer sign-off and approval workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
